ops.body: - **A type save that fails is not said, and a type never reaches the page's own copy while a read has failed** (note-types audit 59): the rejection is caught and the slot goes on showing what is stored, but nothing tells the owner; with the page drawing its sitting's copy (`session`), a pick is stored and not shown until the read succeeds. Fix: say it in the bar as a failed save is, and patch `session`.

- **A second tap on the Type slot within the write's few milliseconds reads the old type** (note-types audit 64): the ask carries the type as it was, so the same pick sets it again instead of clearing. Fix: toggle against the stored value when the write lands.

- **Neutral is a minus in a circle, which reads as "remove", and the eight above the bar have no "No type"** (ux 13; the glyph is note-types audit 23, already deferred): clearing is a tap on the marked one, shown by its tint, rule and heavier name. Fix: a flat-mouthed face when the icon set has one; a ninth "No type" if the owner wants the two pickers alike.

argv: Capture from Chronicle and the journal (HC1-HC15, decision 0112; JN1-JN24, decision 0155)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone, in Memories with the keyboard up, tap the tag in the corner of the entry being written. **Expect:** the eight types appear as two rows of four, named, just above the bar and above the keyboard, with the camera, the mic and Done still in their places; the entry being written is still visible above them; opening More, switching tabs or waiting two minutes takes the eight away. Never run on a device: the taller bar on the keyboard, and the sheet's room with it. (note types NY19, NY25; note-types audit 56)
